callees.name: _is_valid_spec_json
callees.pre_condition: spec_dict is a dict that claims to conform to the .spec.json schema.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when spec_dict is a dict with exactly the keys 'signature', 'pre_condition', 'post_condition' and the value of each key is a string. Returns False when any key is missing or any value is not a string.

callees.name: _is_valid_info_json
callees.pre_condition: info_dict is a dict that claims to conform to the .info.json schema.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when info_dict is a dict containing a 'callees' key. Returns False when the 'callees' key is missing.

callees.name: _normalize_spec_dict
callees.pre_condition: spec_dict is a dict with 'signature', 'pre_condition', 'post_condition' keys whose values are all strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict with strictly the three keys 'signature', 'pre_condition', 'post_condition' and their corresponding string values. Any keys present in spec_dict beyond those three are not present in the returned dict.

callees.name: _normalize_info_dict
callees.pre_condition: info_dict is a dict containing a 'callees' key.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict with strictly the key 'callees' and its corresponding value. Any keys present in info_dict beyond 'callees' are not present in the returned dict.
